newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Thailand releases jailed Cambodian officials.
newsitem.headline: Thailand releases jailed Cambodian officials.

text.p: Thailand has released 11 Cambodian fisheries officials held since September, officials said on Friday.
In an unrelated move, Cambodian officials said four Thai nationals arrested on March 4 for allegedly fishing illegally in Cambodian waters would likely be deported this week after paying a fine.
Authorities in southeast Thailand's Trat province released the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries officials on Thursday afternoon, Thai and Cambodian officials said.

The Cambodians were detained in September last year and held in a Trat prison for allegedly entering Thai waters illegally. The Phnom Penh government maintained they had been in Cambodian waters and demanded their release.
Their detention soured relations between the neighbours, but a Thai diplomat in Phnom Penh said their release "would contribute considerably to (improved) bilateral relations."
He said Cambodian and Thai foreign ministers would preside over an annual meeting of their joint commission in Chiangmai, northern Thailand, and likely would discuss territorial waters.
